purpose: Which text of firestore.rules is live. CI never deploys the rules; a human does, by hand, and the same command records the result here. The offline check (npm run rules:check, tests/rules-deploy-order.spec.ts) compares this record with the working copy and refuses the one order that breaks production: an app that depends on rules which have not been deployed. The online check (npm run rules:verify) asks production what it is actually serving, which is the only way to catch a record that was updated without a deploy.
whyThisExists: On 16.09.2026 it was checked for the first time what cleancore-491216 really serves: the ruleset of 20.08.2026 — three tightenings behind the repository, without anyone knowing. In production `termsVersionAccepted`/`termsAcceptedAt` were still client-writable (finding V14, long closed in the repo), `email_events` not yet locked, and the admin read access to projects still open. Sonny then deployed and the result was checked against the Rules API: identical. This record is meant to make exactly this drift visible from now on.
